name: nirholas/x402-campsites
what_it_holds: TypeScript service (Apache-2.0, 4 stars, 6 commits, created Sep 2026) wrapping the official RIDB campground-metadata API plus Recreation.gov's public, keyless site-level availability API; exposes both as a pay-per-call (USDC micropayment) HTTP/MCP tool with a fallback fixture catalog of 8 campgrounds when no RIDB key is set.

name: mheadd/node-ridb (representative of ~6 RIDB API wrapper repos: AJFunk/ridb-node, boscomonkey/doi-rec-data, jtbradt/ridbAPI, pipeworx-io/mcp-recreation-gov, Dnakitare/recreation-data-manager)
what_it_holds: Thin client libraries (Node/Ruby/.NET/Java/MCP) for USDA/DOI's Recreation Information Database (RIDB) API — facility, campsite, and permit metadata across all US federal recreation lands. No bundled data, needs a free API key.
why_useful: Federal outdoor-recreation demand is a free, government-run book-ahead system that scales across the whole US; a maintained client makes it trivial to build a national capacity-utilization index as a demand-substitute/complement signal.
